_readme: Hand-written Hinglish, Tenglish and Hindi test messages: scams (must be flagged) and genuine ones (must not be), including the genuine warnings banks send in Hinglish and everyday chat that uses the same words. Written by the author from public scam advisories and common SMS wording; NOT real collected messages, so it cannot support an accuracy claim. The real test is the S0 set.
